description: View pushes in: shelves, table and bucket grow larger and shift down across the tiles; room is visibly larger at f11202 than at f11195.
White arrow appears small near the table leg at f11201 and is larger at f11202.
Doctor head tilts down slightly and the soap bar at his chest changes position between tiles (further right at f11348, back left at f11349); movement is small and path not resolvable.
Soap bar travels from beside the doctor chin (f11474) up past his face and head to the upper right (f11481) as his arm line follows; head tilts back down.
Bearded figure is cropped at right edge at f11542 and shows progressively more of his head and shoulders by f11549 while entering from the right.
Room appears slightly larger in the lower row of tiles than the top row; possible slow push-in but low confidence.
Room grows between tiles (beams, shelf and table larger) with the bearded figure cropped more by the right edge at f11699; the word "your" remains visible in every tile.
Word "your" is already on screen at f11692 and stays throughout; only the first word is seen here, so no further text reveal is evidenced.
"medieval science" slides upward: centred at f11817, near top at f11820, and clipped by the top edge by f11824.
Title remnant "...eval science" is mostly above the top edge at f12010 and is gone by f12017.
Blobs and labels drift slightly upward across tiles while all four labels (blood, phlegm, yellow bile, black bile) are present; drift small, may be layout settle.
White card with "Simple solution?" shows no visible change across tiles (measured diff 1.06).
Doctor head and the raised knife shift slightly between tiles; patient and room static; exact knife path not resolved.
Doctor eyes look closed/half-closed at f12357-12358 (blink) and reopen by f12359; knife held in raised hand tilts across the tiles.
Shirtless bearded figure enters from the right edge: only a sliver at f12465, partly visible at f12466, fully in position at f12467.
Black arrow appears between the two figures: tiny at f12470 and larger at f12471.
Red vertical bar with 100%/0% labels appears at f12514 at both far left and far right edges, then a single gauge sits on the right from f12515.
Whole layout slides left: robed figure exits left edge by f12515-12516, arrow and shirtless figure move left, gauge moves toward centre.
Doctor holds the yellow flask; flask position and doctor head change slightly between tiles; eyes look half-closed at f12861-12862 (possible blink).
Flask is held near the doctor chin; small shifts in flask and eyes across tiles; not resolved further.
Colour bars show horizontal tearing/line displacement with compressed upper bars (analog glitch look).
Bars become stable and full-height from f13031; a noisy band remains along the bottom edge and shrinks, bars stay still.
Doctor head and background elements change position slightly between tiles (camera drift or character sway); cannot separate.
Doctor, cropped at left edge at f13190, moves right into frame and dips his head by f13194-13197; shelf background does not move.
Leeches on the torso shift position slightly between tiles; leech outlines move by small amounts, no large travel seen.
Another leech tip touches the bottom edge of the frame at f13414-13415 and is not seen in the following tiles.
Doctor head and body shift slightly, eyes look toward the patient; patient stays still.
Tiny white text, readable at this scale as "witch", appears near the doctor chin/mouth at f13914 and drifts right and slightly larger by f13921.
Doctor head leans lower toward the patient and eyes look down across the tiles.
